prompt: Where was Moses when God spoke the words recorded in Moses 1?
options: Caught up into an exceedingly high mountain
In the land of Midian at a well
explanation: Moses was caught up into an exceedingly high mountain.

prompt: In Moses 1:4, God calls Moses what?
explanation: God said, Behold, thou art my son.

prompt: Who came tempting Moses after God's presence withdrew in Moses 1?
explanation: Satan came tempting him, saying, Moses, son of man, worship me.

prompt: In whose name did Moses finally command Satan to depart?
explanation: Moses commanded Satan in the name of the Only Begotten to depart.

prompt: In Moses 1:33, by whom did God say He created worlds without number?
explanation: Worlds without number have I created by the Son, mine Only Begotten.

prompt: According to Moses 1:39, what is God's work and glory?
options: To bring to pass the immortality and eternal life of man
explanation: God's work and glory is the immortality and eternal life of man.

prompt: Moses 1:41 foretells that God will raise up another like unto whom to restore His words?
explanation: God would raise up another like unto Moses.

prompt: In Moses 2:1, who is speaking to Moses about the creation?
explanation: I, God, spake unto Moses about the creation.

prompt: According to Moses 3:5, the Lord created all things how, before they were naturally upon the earth?
explanation: I, the Lord God, created all things spiritually, before they were naturally upon the face of the earth.

prompt: From what did the Lord God form man, according to Moses 3:7?
explanation: The Lord God formed man from the dust of the ground.

prompt: In Moses 4:1, who proposed to redeem all mankind so that not one soul be lost?
explanation: Satan sought to redeem all mankind that one soul shall not be lost, seeking God's honor.

prompt: According to Moses 4:2, to whom did the Beloved Son say, "Thy will be done, and the glory be thine forever"?
explanation: The Beloved Son said, Father, thy will be done.

prompt: Satan sought to destroy what, according to Moses 4:3?
explanation: Satan sought to destroy the agency of man.

prompt: Why did Adam call his wife's name Eve?
options: She was first to eat the fruit
She was the mother of all living
explanation: Adam called his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all living.

prompt: What did Adam and Eve offer, as the Lord commanded, after leaving the garden?
explanation: They were commanded to offer the firstlings of their flocks.

prompt: Who explained to Adam that his sacrifice was a similitude of the sacrifice of the Only Begotten?
explanation: An angel of the Lord appeared and explained the sacrifice.

prompt: Who said that were it not for the transgression, they never should have had seed?
explanation: Eve, his wife, heard all these things and was glad.

prompt: What title did Cain take after making a secret combination with Satan?
explanation: Cain called himself Mahan, master of the great secret, and was called Master Mahan.

prompt: Where did Cain dwell after he was shut out from the presence of the Lord?
explanation: Cain dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

prompt: According to Moses 6:5, a book of what was kept in the language of Adam?
explanation: A book of remembrance was kept, in the language of Adam.

prompt: Why did Enoch say all the people hated him?
explanation: Enoch said he was but a lad, and slow of speech.

prompt: What did the Lord tell Enoch to anoint his eyes with?
explanation: Anoint thine eyes with clay, and wash them, and thou shalt see.

prompt: What did Enoch behold after anointing his eyes, which were not visible to the natural eye?
explanation: He beheld the spirits that God had created.

prompt: When people came to hear Enoch, what did they say they were going to behold?
explanation: They went to behold the seer, for he prophesied.

prompt: In Moses 6:64, who was caught away by the Spirit and carried down into the water and baptized?
explanation: Our father Adam was caught away by the Spirit of the Lord into the water.

prompt: What did the Lord call His people in Enoch's day because they were of one heart and one mind?
explanation: The Lord called his people Zion, because they were of one heart and one mind.

prompt: According to Moses 7:18, Zion had how many poor among them?
explanation: There was no poor among them.

prompt: What was Enoch's city called?
options: The City of Holiness, even Zion
explanation: Enoch built a city called the City of Holiness, even Zion.

prompt: What happened to Zion in process of time?
options: It was taken up into heaven
explanation: Zion, in process of time, was taken up into heaven.

prompt: In Moses 7:28, Enoch beheld the God of heaven do what over the residue of the people?
explanation: The God of heaven looked upon the residue of the people, and he wept.

prompt: How many years were all the days of Zion in Enoch's days?
explanation: All the days of Zion were three hundred and sixty-five years.

prompt: Methuselah was the son of whom?
explanation: Methuselah was the son of Enoch.

prompt: Why was Methuselah not taken with Zion?
options: That the covenants of the Lord might be fulfilled
explanation: Methuselah was not taken, that the covenants the Lord made with Enoch might be fulfilled.

prompt: Moses 8:13 says Noah and his sons hearkened unto the Lord and were called what?
explanation: Noah and his sons were called the sons of God.

prompt: Moses 8:27 describes Noah as a just man and perfect in his what?
explanation: Noah was a just man, and perfect in his generation.

prompt: In Abraham 1, Abraham lived in which land when he sought a new place of residence?
explanation: In the land of the Chaldeans, Abraham saw it was needful to obtain another place.

prompt: Abraham 1:2 says Abraham sought for the blessings of the fathers and the right to do what?
explanation: He sought the right whereunto he should be ordained to administer the same.

prompt: What had Abraham's fathers attempted to do to him because he refused their gods?
options: Take away his life by sacrifice
explanation: They endeavored to take away his life by the hand of the priest of Elkenah.

prompt: As Abraham was about to be offered up, who stood by him and immediately unloosed his bands?
explanation: Abraham 1:15 says the angel of his presence stood by him and immediately unloosed his bands.

prompt: What caused Abraham's father to repent of the evil he had planned against Abraham?
options: A famine in the land of Chaldea
The death of the priest of Elkenah
explanation: A famine prevailed throughout Chaldea, and Abraham's father repented.

prompt: Whom did Abraham take to wife?
explanation: Abraham took Sarai to wife.

prompt: Which nephew went with Abraham from Ur?
explanation: Lot, my brother's son, and his wife went with me.

prompt: Where did Abraham sojourn when he prayed and the Lord appeared, telling him to go to a strange land?
explanation: Abraham dwelt in Haran when the Lord appeared unto him.

prompt: Abraham 2:11 promises that in Abraham's seed shall all the families of the earth be what?
explanation: In thee and thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

prompt: How old was Abraham when he departed out of Haran?
explanation: Abraham was sixty and two years old when he departed out of Haran.

prompt: Besides Sarai, Lot, and their substance, whom did Abraham bring from Haran toward Canaan?
options: The souls that we had won in Haran
explanation: Abraham took the souls that we had won in Haran and came forth toward the land of Canaan.

prompt: What instrument did Abraham have, which the Lord gave him in Ur?
explanation: Abraham had the Urim and Thummim, which the Lord had given him in Ur.

prompt: What is the name of the great star nearest to the throne of God, according to Abraham 3?
explanation: The name of the great one is Kolob, near unto the throne of God.

prompt: According to Abraham 3:4, one day of Kolob equals how many years by the reckoning of this earth?
explanation: One revolution of Kolob is a day unto the Lord, a thousand years.

prompt: In Abraham 3:13, what is Shinehah?
explanation: Shinehah, which is the sun.

prompt: In Abraham 3:13, what is Olea?
explanation: Olea, which is the moon.

prompt: Abraham was shown the intelligences organized before the world was. What were many of them?
explanation: Among them were many of the noble and great ones.

prompt: In Abraham 3:23, God told Abraham he was chosen when?
explanation: Abraham, thou art one of them; thou wast chosen before thou wast born.

prompt: According to Abraham 3:25, why is this life given?
explanation: We will prove them herewith, to see if they will do all things God commands.

prompt: According to Abraham 3:26, those who keep their first estate shall be what?
explanation: They who keep their first estate shall be added upon.

prompt: In Abraham 3:27, the Lord asked, "Whom shall I send?" How did one like unto the Son of Man answer?
options: I will go, give me thine honor
Who am I that I should go
explanation: One answered like unto the Son of Man: Here am I, send me.

prompt: How did the second who offered react when the Lord chose the first?
options: He was angry and kept not his first estate
explanation: The second was angry, and kept not his first estate.

prompt: In Abraham 4:1, who went down at the beginning to form the heavens and the earth?
explanation: They, that is the Gods, organized and formed the heavens and the earth.

prompt: In Joseph Smith—Matthew, where was Jesus sitting when the disciples asked about the signs of His coming?
explanation: Jesus sat upon the Mount of Olives, and the disciples came to Him privately.

prompt: According to Joseph Smith—Matthew 1:37, whoso treasureth up whose word shall not be deceived?
explanation: Whoso treasureth up my word, shall not be deceived.

prompt: In Joseph Smith—Matthew, the coming of the Son of Man will be as it was in the days of whom?
explanation: As it was in the days of Noah, so it shall be also at the coming of the Son of Man.

prompt: Which tree's tender branches signal summer is nigh, in Joseph Smith—Matthew?
explanation: Learn a parable of the fig-tree.

prompt: In what state was Joseph Smith born, according to his history?
explanation: Joseph was born in Sharon, Windsor County, Vermont.

prompt: In what year was Joseph Smith born?
explanation: Joseph Smith was born on the twenty-third of December, 1805.

prompt: Into which town in New York did Joseph Smith's family later move, before Manchester?
explanation: The family moved to Palmyra, Ontario (now Wayne) County, New York.

prompt: What was Joseph Smith's mother's maiden name?
explanation: His mother was Lucy Smith, whose name before marriage was Mack.

prompt: What occurred in the place where Joseph lived in the second year after the family moved to Manchester?
options: An unusual excitement on the subject of religion
explanation: There was an unusual excitement on the subject of religion.

prompt: How old was Joseph Smith during the religious excitement?
explanation: Joseph was at that time in his fifteenth year.

prompt: Which church did four members of Joseph Smith's family join?
explanation: His mother, Hyrum, Samuel Harrison, and Sophronia joined the Presbyterian faith.

prompt: Toward which sect did Joseph Smith say his mind became somewhat partial?
explanation: In process of time my mind became somewhat partial to the Methodist sect.

prompt: Which epistle did Joseph read while seeking which church to join?
explanation: Joseph read the Epistle of James, first chapter and fifth verse.

prompt: In what year did the First Vision occur?
explanation: It was early in the spring of eighteen hundred and twenty.

prompt: What happened as soon as Joseph Smith began to pray?
options: He saw a pillar of light
He was seized by a power that bound his tongue
explanation: He was seized upon by some power which entirely overcame him.

prompt: What descended upon Joseph Smith, brighter than the sun?
explanation: Joseph saw a pillar of light exactly over his head.

prompt: How many Personages did Joseph Smith see in the First Vision?
explanation: Joseph saw two Personages standing above him in the air.

prompt: Joseph was told that the professors of the creeds draw near with their lips but their hearts are what?
explanation: They draw near to me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.

prompt: Whom did Joseph first tell, upon returning home, that he had learned Presbyterianism was not true?
explanation: Joseph said to his mother, I have learned for myself that Presbyterianism is not true.

prompt: With whom did Joseph share his vision a few days after it occurred, who treated it with contempt?
explanation: Joseph told one of the Methodist preachers, who treated it with great contempt.

prompt: To whom did Joseph compare himself in feeling much like, when he told of seeing a vision?
explanation: Joseph felt much like Paul when he made his defense before King Agrippa.

prompt: On what date in 1823 did Joseph pray and Moroni appear?
explanation: On the evening of the twenty-first of September, 1823, Joseph prayed.

prompt: What was the name of the messenger who appeared to Joseph Smith in 1823?
explanation: The messenger said his name was Moroni.

prompt: On what was the book of record deposited by Moroni written?
explanation: There was a book deposited, written upon gold plates.

prompt: What two stones in silver bows were deposited with the plates?
options: The seer stone and the compass
explanation: Two stones in silver bows constituted the Urim and Thummim.

prompt: How was Moroni dressed when he appeared at Joseph's bedside?
options: In a loose robe of exquisite whiteness
explanation: He had on a loose robe of most exquisite whiteness.

prompt: Where was Moroni standing when he appeared in Joseph's room?
options: In the air, his feet not touching the floor
explanation: He stood in the air, for his feet did not touch the floor.

prompt: Which Old Testament prophet did Moroni quote first, with some variation?
explanation: Moroni first quoted part of the third chapter of Malachi.

prompt: Which chapter of Isaiah did Moroni say was about to be fulfilled?
explanation: Moroni quoted the eleventh chapter of Isaiah.

prompt: Which chapter of Acts did Moroni quote?
explanation: Moroni quoted the third chapter of Acts, twenty-second and twenty-third verses.

prompt: Which chapter of Joel did Moroni quote?
explanation: He quoted the second chapter of Joel, from the twenty-eighth verse.

prompt: How many times did Moroni visit Joseph during the night of September 21-22, 1823?
explanation: Moroni appeared three times that night with the same message.

prompt: What did Moroni instruct Joseph to do in the field the next day?
options: Tell his father of the vision
explanation: Moroni commanded him to go to his father and tell him of the vision.

prompt: In what lay the plates on the hill near Manchester?
explanation: The plates were deposited in a box of stone.

prompt: When was Joseph told to come back to the hill after his first visit there?
options: Never; he was not to return
Precisely in one year from that time
explanation: The messenger told him to come to that place precisely in one year, and to continue doing so.

prompt: In which state was Joseph Smith working for Josiah Stoal?
explanation: Josiah Stoal lived in Chenango county, State of New York.

prompt: Whom did Joseph Smith marry on January 18, 1827?
explanation: Joseph met Emma Hale while boarding with her father; they married January 18, 1827.

prompt: On what date did Joseph receive the plates?
explanation: On the twenty-second of September, 1827, the messenger delivered them up to him.

prompt: Who helped Joseph with fifty dollars to move to Pennsylvania?
explanation: Martin Harris, a farmer, gave Joseph fifty dollars.

prompt: To which professor did Martin Harris show the characters in New York City?
explanation: Martin Harris went to Professor Charles Anthon.

prompt: Which phrase did Professor Anthon reportedly say when Martin said an angel revealed the plates?
options: I cannot read a sealed book
explanation: Professor Anthon said, I cannot read a sealed book.

prompt: Who came to Joseph's home on April 5, 1829, and began to write for him?
explanation: On the 5th day of April, 1829, Oliver Cowdery came to Joseph's house.

prompt: In which month of 1829 did Joseph and Oliver go into the woods to inquire about baptism?
explanation: In May 1829 they went into the woods to pray about baptism for the remission of sins.

prompt: Under the direction of which apostles did John the Baptist say he acted?
explanation: John acted under the direction of Peter, James, and John.

prompt: Who baptized whom first in May 1829?
explanation: Joseph first baptized Oliver, and afterward Oliver baptized him.

prompt: What did Joseph and Oliver experience immediately after their baptism?
options: The Holy Ghost fell upon them and they prophesied
explanation: The Holy Ghost fell upon them and they prophesied.

prompt: According to the first article of faith, we believe in God, the Eternal Father, His Son Jesus Christ, and whom?
explanation: We believe in God, the Eternal Father, his Son, Jesus Christ, and the Holy Ghost.

prompt: According to the second article of faith, men will be punished for their own sins and not for whose?
explanation: Men will be punished for their own sins, and not for Adam's transgression.

prompt: According to the fourth article of faith, which is the first principle of the gospel?
options: The gift of the Holy Ghost
Faith in the Lord Jesus Christ
explanation: The first principles are faith, then repentance, then baptism, then the Holy Ghost.

prompt: The fifth article of faith says a man must be called of God by prophecy and by what?
explanation: A man must be called of God by prophecy and by the laying on of hands.

prompt: Which of these officers is listed in the sixth article of faith?
explanation: The sixth article lists apostles, prophets, pastors, teachers, evangelists.

prompt: According to the eighth article of faith, we believe the Bible to be the word of God as far as it is what?
explanation: As far as it is translated correctly.

prompt: According to the tenth article of faith, upon which continent will Zion (the New Jerusalem) be built?
explanation: Zion will be built upon the American continent.

prompt: The eleventh article of faith claims the privilege of worshiping according to the dictates of what?
explanation: Worshiping Almighty God according to the dictates of our own conscience.

prompt: The twelfth article of faith says we believe in obeying, honoring, and sustaining what?
explanation: We believe in obeying, honoring, and sustaining the law.

prompt: According to the thirteenth article of faith, we follow the admonition of which apostle?
explanation: We may say that we follow the admonition of Paul.

prompt: The thirteenth article of faith says we hope all things and have endured many things, and hope to be able to endure what?
explanation: We have endured many things, and hope to be able to endure all things.

prompt: According to the ninth article of faith, we believe God will yet reveal many great and important things pertaining to what?
explanation: He will yet reveal many great and important things pertaining to the Kingdom of God.

prompt: According to the third article of faith, all mankind may be saved through Christ's Atonement by obedience to what?
options: The laws and ordinances of the Gospel
explanation: Through the Atonement, all mankind may be saved by obedience to the laws and ordinances.

prompt: Which of these gifts is NOT named in the seventh article of faith?
explanation: The seventh article names tongues, prophecy, revelation, visions, healing, interpretation of tongues.
